tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: 自然期刊研究指出：追求評估準確度或加劇語言模型幻覺
articles.title_en: Nature study finds optimizing LLMs for accuracy may incentivize hallucinations
articles.lede_zh: 一項刊於自然期刊的論文顯示，當大型語言模型被設定為優先追求評估準確度時，可能反而促使模型更容易產生幻覺內容。這項發現對當前的模型評估框架提出重要質疑。研究結果或將重塑整個業界對語言模型能力的評價標準。
articles.lede_en: A newly published Nature paper reveals that training large language models to prioritize accuracy metrics may paradoxically increase their tendency to generate false information. The findings challenge conventional evaluation approaches widely used across the AI industry.
bullets_zh: 研究於二零二六年四月刊於自然期刊
質疑現行模型評估指標的設計邏輯
可能重新引導未來大型語言模型訓練方向
bullets_en: The research paper was published in April 2026 by Nature journal
The study directly challenges current model evaluation metric designs
Results could reshape future artificial intelligence training strategies

articles.title_zh: 特斯拉確認HW3車輛不獲升級無人監督自動駕駛功能
articles.title_en: Tesla confirms Hardware 3 vehicles will not receive unsupervised Full Self-Driving
articles.lede_zh: 執行長馬斯克於第一季財報會議上確認，搭載HW3電腦的特斯拉車輛將無法使用無人監督全自動駕駛功能，約影響四百萬名車主。部分車主購車時已付費購買該服務。
articles.lede_en: CEO Elon Musk confirmed during the Q1 earnings call that Tesla vehicles equipped with the HW3 computer will not gain access to unsupervised Full Self-Driving. Approximately four million vehicles are affected, including customers who previously paid for the feature.
bullets_zh: 約四百萬輛搭載HW3的車輛受到影響
部分車主購買時已預先支付相關費用
特斯拉正逐步轉向新一代自駕硬體平台
bullets_en: Approximately four million vehicles running on HW3 platform are affected
Some vehicle owners already paid for the self-driving feature upgrade
Tesla now shifting development focus to newer autonomous hardware generations

articles.title_zh: OpenAI開放醫療版ChatGPT供美國醫護人員免費使用
articles.title_en: OpenAI makes ChatGPT for Clinicians free for verified physicians and healthcare professionals
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI宣布經認證的美國醫師、護理師及藥師可免費使用醫療版ChatGPT。該工具旨在協助臨床照護、醫療文件處理及醫學研究等用途，以減輕醫護人員的行政負擔。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI announced that verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists can access ChatGPT for Clinicians at no cost. The tool supports clinical documentation, patient care workflows, and medical research tasks for healthcare professionals.
bullets_zh: 美國經認證的醫療人員皆可免費使用
支援臨床照護與醫療文件處理等應用
持續拓展人工智慧在醫療領域的應用範圍
bullets_en: Verified medical professionals in the United States get free platform access
Tools support clinical documentation alongside patient care daily workflows
Company continues expanding artificial intelligence adoption across healthcare settings

articles.title_zh: OpenAI推出工作區代理功能助力企業自動化流程
articles.title_en: OpenAI introduces workspace agents to automate repeatable team workflows in ChatGPT
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI推出工作區代理功能，讓使用者可在ChatGPT中建立、使用並擴展自動化代理。該功能用於串接工具與優化流程，提升團隊營運效率，並提供教學指南協助部署。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI launched workspace agents, enabling users to build, use, and scale automated agents within ChatGPT. The feature connects tools and automates repetitive workflows to streamline team operations across different enterprise departments.
bullets_zh: 使用者可於ChatGPT內建立自動化代理
支援串接外部工具與客製化工作流程
搭配教學指南協助企業完成應用部署
bullets_en: Users can now create automated agents directly within the ChatGPT platform
Feature supports integration with external tools and custom workflow design
Comprehensive tutorials help organizations deploy agents for enterprise use cases

articles.title_zh: Intuit工程師分享大規模AI代理系統協作經驗
articles.title_en: Intuit engineers share insights on managing multiple AI agents working together at scale
articles.lede_zh: Intuit的工程主管在播客中分享大型系統中多重AI代理協作的實務經驗。他們指出這可能是當前軟體工程領域最具挑戰性的問題之一，涉及跨代理溝通與任務分配的複雜性。
articles.lede_en: Engineering leaders at Intuit shared their experience managing multiple AI agents in a podcast. They described coordinating agents in complex systems as one of the most challenging engineering problems today, noting the difficulties of cross-agent communication and task delegation.
bullets_zh: Intuit分享多重代理系統之協作實務經驗
協調代理被視為軟體領域重大技術挑戰
研究著重於企業層級的系統擴展能力
bullets_en: Intuit engineering leaders share practical multi-agent coordination experiences publicly
Coordinating multiple agents is described as a major software challenge
Research focuses on scaling agent systems to enterprise-level infrastructure needs

articles.title_zh: 特斯拉宣布資本支出增至二百五十億美元布局人工智慧
articles.title_en: Tesla raises capital expenditure to twenty-five billion dollars for artificial intelligence
articles.lede_zh: 特斯拉將資本支出上調至二百五十億美元，執行長馬斯克預示將擴增自駕計程車、機器人及晶片工廠的投資。他警告投資人未來支出將持續增加，涵蓋所有人工智慧相關業務。
articles.lede_en: Tesla increased capital expenditure to twenty-five billion dollars. CEO Elon Musk signaled significant expansion into autonomous taxi networks, robotics and semiconductor manufacturing, warning investors to expect further spending increases across all AI-related units.
bullets_zh: 資本支出上調至二百五十億美元規模
投資範圍涵蓋自駕車與機器人等多項技術
馬斯克預告資本支出未來仍將持續成長
bullets_en: Capital expenditure budget raised to twenty-five billion dollar total spending
Investment portfolio covers autonomous vehicles and robotics technologies broadly
Musk warns shareholders that capital spending will continue rising steadily

articles.title_zh: 自然期刊發表糖原與細胞代謝物泛素化新機制研究
articles.title_en: Nature publishes study on ubiquitination of glycogen and metabolites in cells and tissues
articles.lede_zh: 自然期刊發表一篇關於細胞組織中糖原及代謝物泛素化的研究論文。該研究團隊首次系統性地分析了泛素化在細胞代謝調控中的新角色，為代謝相關疾病研究開啟全新方向。
articles.lede_en: Nature published a paper examining ubiquitination of glycogen and metabolites across cells and tissues. The research reveals new roles for this biochemical modification in cellular metabolic regulation and opens pathways for understanding disease mechanisms tied to metabolic dysfunction.
bullets_zh: 該研究於二零二六年四月刊於自然期刊
首次系統性探討細胞代謝物之泛素化現象
為代謝相關疾病之研究開啟全新方向
bullets_en: Research findings published in April 2026 edition of Nature journal
Study systematically examines ubiquitination process in cellular metabolites today
Creates new research pathways for understanding metabolic disease mechanisms worldwide

articles.title_zh: 美伊於荷莫茲海峽陷入封鎖對峙巴基斯坦推動和談
articles.title_en: U.S. and Iran face standoff over blockade as Pakistan pushes for diplomatic talks
articles.lede_zh: 儘管川普政府已宣布延長停火協議，荷莫茲海峽的緊繃局勢仍未有效降溫。巴基斯坦正積極展開外交斡旋，試圖緩和該區域的安全危機。此海峽是全球關鍵的石油運輸通道。
articles.lede_en: Tensions remain high in the Strait of Hormuz despite the Trump administration's ceasefire extension. Pakistan is actively pushing for diplomatic negotiations to help ease the volatile security situation in the region, working to prevent further escalation between Washington and Tehran.
bullets_zh: 川普政府已延長停火協議但局勢未見和緩
巴基斯坦積極推動外交斡旋以避免衝突擴大
海峽為全球關鍵石油運輸航線具重要戰略地位
bullets_en: Trump administration extended ceasefire agreement but regional tensions remain unresolved
Pakistan actively pursuing diplomatic negotiations to prevent further military escalation
Strait remains critical global petroleum shipping route of strategic importance

articles.title_zh: 十六家金融機構攜手打造在地金融專屬大語言模型
articles.title_en: Sixteen financial institutions collaborate to build local financial large language model in Taiwan
articles.lede_zh: 金融科技產業聯盟聯手十六家金融機構啟動金融大語言模型專案，以開源模型為基礎結合在地語料訓練。此專案旨在取代各機構重複開發的成本，預定今年底完成最終版本。
articles.lede_en: The Fintech Industry Alliance partnered with sixteen financial institutions to develop a local financial large language model. The project uses open-source foundations combined with Taiwanese corpora and regulatory knowledge, replacing duplicative development efforts across individual banks.
bullets_zh: 共有十六家金融業者參與此聯合開發專案
模型將結合金融法規與在地產業知識進行訓練
預定今年底完成最終版本並交由第三方維護
bullets_en: Sixteen financial institutions actively participating in joint development initiative together
Model training combines local financial regulatory knowledge with industry corpora
Final model version expected by year end with third-party maintenance

articles.title_zh: GitHub宣布暫停Copilot新申請並全面收緊用量限制
articles.title_en: GitHub pauses new Copilot subscriptions and tightens usage limits across pricing tiers
articles.lede_zh: GitHub宣布暫停Copilot Pro及學生版新用戶申請，同步收緊個人方案用量上限，並將Opus系列模型自Pro方案移除。此舉旨在控制代理式工作流程所帶來的龐大運算成本。
articles.lede_en: GitHub announced a pause on new Copilot Pro and Student subscriptions, tightened usage caps across personal tiers, and removed Opus-series models from the Pro plan. The changes address rising computational costs driven by increasingly popular agent-based workflows.
bullets_zh: 全面暫停Copilot Pro與學生版新用戶申請
Opus系列模型自Pro方案中正式移除
代理式工作流程導致伺服器運算成本攀升
bullets_en: Company fully paused new Copilot Pro and Student tier subscription registrations
Opus model series officially removed from existing Pro tier subscription plan
Enterprise agent-based workflows driving substantial server computational cost increases
